mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real GDP growth signals a weakening economy that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings estimates are revised downward.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending slows.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower in triggered periods than non-triggered (t-test p > 0.1)

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating rise in industrial production signals a strengthening economy that will produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings estimates are revised upward.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.1 over any 3-year rolling window

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as borrowing costs rise and discount rates applied to equity cash flows increase.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts signals a weakening housing market that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as related sectors like homebuilding and construction slow.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower in triggered periods than non-triggered (t-test p > 0.1)

mechanism_narrative: A rapid acceleration in payroll employment growth signals a strengthening labor market that will produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending accelerates.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in retail sales signals a strengthening consumer sector that will produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as related sectors like retail and consumer discretionary outperform.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly higher in triggered periods than non-triggered (t-test p > 0.1)

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the consumer price index signals rising inflation expectations that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in higher future discount rates.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.1 over any 3-year rolling window
